name: voxelhorizon
description: VoxelHorizon v3.2 Anime Edition — Hybrid Rust-WASM + Full Multiplayer Sync, In-Settings Mod Hub, Anime HD Textures/GUI/Cover & Studio IDE

scripts.prepare-www: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','style.css','textures.js','world.js','entities.js','multiplayer_mods.js','studio.js','game.js','cover_anime.jpg','anime_tiles.png','icon.png','ost_overworld_day.wav','ost_overworld_night.wav','ost_nether.wav','ost_boss.wav'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f);}); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/three/build/three.min.js','www/three.min.js'); fs.copyFileSync('node_modules/peerjs/dist/peerjs.min.js','www/peerjs.min.js'); console.log('Prepared www/ Anime Edition bundle (>32MB)');"
